title: FB-002 keep adjacent media out of final-library sidecars
summary: Prevent final-library promotion from treating adjacent dot-suffixed media files as companion sidecars.
reason: Worker finding FR-004 identified that final-library promotion sidecar discovery can include adjacent media files such as Movie.2160p.mkv, allowing cleanup-after-verified to delete them after a verified promotion transaction.
behavior_before: Final-library companion sidecar discovery accepted any file whose name started with the primary media stem plus a dot, so adjacent media such as Movie.2160p.mkv entered the promotion copy plan and cleanup-after-verified delete list.
behavior_after: Companion sidecar discovery excludes candidates whose own suffix is a recognized media suffix. Adjacent media remains in the publish tree, is not copied as a sidecar, and is not deleted by cleanup-after-verified.
tests_added: Python final-library promotion regressions proving adjacent dot-suffixed media is excluded from companion sidecar discovery and survives cleanup-after-verified.
manual_validation: Bundled Python with PYTHONPATH=src: python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_final_library_promotion.FinalLibraryPromotionTests.test_fast_and_cautious_transfer_copy_sidecars_and_cleanup_verified_outputs tests.python.desktop.test_final_library_promotion.FinalLibraryPromotionTests.test_sidecar_discovery_uses_primary_stem_and_excludes_temp_files -q passed, 2 tests.
Bundled Python with PYTHONPATH=src: python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_final_library_promotion.FinalLibraryPromotionTests -q passed, 24 tests.
Bundled Python with PYTHONPATH=src: python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_final_library_promotion.FinalLibraryPromotionServiceTests -q passed, 4 tests.

Bundled Python with PYTHONPATH=src: python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_final_library_promotion -q failed one unrelated WebView static-copy assertion expecting the old home promotion button text.

Bundled Python: mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage failed only for unrelated uncovered dirty files docs/implementation/encoder-breadth-av1-plan.md and docs/reviews/function-module-audit-2026-06-11/workers/worker-08-webview-pages.md.
rollback_plan: Revert the final-library companion sidecar filtering and test updates, then rerun focused final-library promotion tests.
notes: Source/output cleanup boundary change. Focused temp-directory tests are required; representative operator validation is recommended before enabling cleanup-after-verified in production.
